title: Saved window state
whyItMatters: Which apps had which windows and document titles open; Terminal state can include visible text.
source: macforensics.app artifact cheat sheet (Saved Application State)

steps: Quit every open app first, because a closing app writes its saved window state.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it still exists.
cleanup.risk: Apps forget which windows and documents were open at the next launch; no document content is deleted.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Delete files and folders on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/delete-files-and-folders-on-mac-mchlp1093/mac
